name: update_plan
description: Create or revise the task plan in todos.md. action='create': write a new plan from scratch. action='revise': replace a failed task with smaller tasks and record what was tried, so the plan preserves a history of failed approaches.

action.description: create: write new todos.md content. revise: replace a failed task with replacement tasks and append a failure record.

failed_task.description: (action=revise) Text of the failed task as it appears after '- [ ]' in todos.md.

tried.description: (action=revise) What was attempted and why it failed. Recorded as a '- ✗' line in the plan so future iterations do not repeat it.

replacement_tasks.description: (action=revise) Newline-separated replacement tasks to insert before the failure record. Include '[decomposed] ' prefix where appropriate.

execution.command_template:
printf '%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s\x00%s' '{{action}}' '{{plan}}' '{{failed_task}}' '{{tried}}' '{{replacement_tasks}}' | python3 -c "
import sys, re
data = sys.stdin.read()
parts = data.split('\x00')
action = parts[0] if len(parts) > 0 else ''
plan = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
failed_task = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ''
tried = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else ''
replacement_tasks = parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else ''
if action == 'create':
    open('todos.md', 'w').write(plan.strip() + '\n')
    print('Plan created.')
elif action == 'revise':
    try:
        lines = open('todos.md').readlines()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print('todos.md not found', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    target = failed_task.strip()
    idx = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip().startswith('- [ ]') and target in line:
            idx = i
            break
    if idx is None:
        print('Task not found: ' + target, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    task_text = re.sub(r'^-\s*\[.\]\s*', '', lines[idx].strip())
    new_lines = []
    for task in replacement_tasks.strip().split('\n'):
        task = task.strip()
        if task:
            new_lines.append('- [ ] ' + task + '\n')
    new_lines.append('- \u2717 ' + task_text + ' \u2014 ' + tried.strip() + '\n')
    lines = lines[:idx] + new_lines + lines[idx+1:]
    open('todos.md', 'w').writelines(lines)
    print('Plan revised: ' + str(len(new_lines)-1) + ' replacement task(s) added, failure recorded.')
else:
    print('Unknown action: ' + action, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
"
